about.text: Galactooligosaccharides (GOS), also known as oligogalactosyllactose, oligogalactose, oligolactose or transgalactooligosaccharides (TOS), belong to the group of prebiotics. Prebiotics are defined as non-digestible food ingredients that beneficially affect the host by stimulating the growth and/or activity of beneficial bacteria in the colon. GOS occurs in commercially available products such as food for both infants and adults.

how.text: The same enzyme that splits lactose into glucose and galactose also, at high lactose concentration, hooks the galactose onto other sugars instead of water. The result is a mix of short galactose chains with a glucose at the end. Yield depends on enzyme, lactose concentration and how far the reaction is run.
